LanguageData.RL_VehicleNoSurface: The entire vehicle needs a supported, drivable surface.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleRouteLost: No usable vehicle route remains. The vehicle has stopped.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleRecoverHelp: Unload a held vehicle at this station in the same shaft, if its entire footprint is clear.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleRampWidth: Aligned modules beside this ramp form its usable width.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleDeckSupport: Each corner of the nine-cell cabin needs an existing supported platform alongside it.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleShaftClear: This cell is not part of a finished lift opening. Open the shaft from the station on the floor below first.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleRampUpper: Open the adjacent upper floor before building a ramp.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleRampOpening: Clear the space above all six ramp cells; roofs, slabs and rock cannot intersect the slope.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleRampLanding: The upper end needs a supported landing.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleRampJoin: Only side-by-side modules with the same start and direction can join.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleChooseFloorHelp: Choose a stop in this lift shaft. The vehicle must be fully inside the cabin and ready to drive.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleNoFloorRoute: No opened lift shaft reaches another floor from this cabin. Both stations must be aligned, powered and the shaft fully excavated.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleNotReady: The vehicle is not ready to drive. Check ignition, crew, fuel and damage.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleCancelHelp: Cancel the trip. A vehicle on a ramp backs down to its entry; a lift returns it to a legal source station. If unloading is blocked, the original vehicle stays in custody.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleRecoverBlocked: No held vehicle can unload here. Clear the whole footprint and restore a supported station in the same shaft.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleShaftOccupied: Paused: a person or vehicle occupies the shaft.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleRestoreSource: The original vehicle is held safely. Clear its full footprint and restore the supported source platform or lift station. It will unload when that location is safe.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleLandingUnavailable: The destination floor or map is unavailable.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleAirCorridorBlocked: The aircraft’s air corridor is obstructed.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleLandingRestriction: The aircraft’s landing restrictions are not met.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleLandingHeld: {0}: landing suspended. {1} Choose another landing site.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleDigNeedStation: Build an aligned vehicle lift station on the floor immediately below first.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleDigBusy: Finish or cancel vehicle journeys in this shaft first.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleDigClear: Mine the rock and clear vehicles and other obstructions from both cabins first.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleDigNatural: Excavation needs dry ground with no foundation. Water, impassable cells and ship foundations block the order; slabs, flooring and natural rock do not.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleDigComplete: Shaft to the floor below is open
LanguageData.RL_VehicleDigCompleteUp: Shaft to the floor above is open
LanguageData.RL_VehicleDigHelp: Open the shaft to the floor below. An aligned station must already stand one floor down. Miners cut one cell at a time (600 work for rock, 120 for built flooring) and clear this cabin's ceiling, turning this station into the opening. Built slabs and paving are consumed, never refunded. The finished shaft carries vehicles in both directions; pausing keeps openings and progress.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleDigHelpUp: Open the floor above this station. Miners cut the covering slab, flooring or natural rock above one cell at a time (600 work for rock, 120 for built flooring) and clear the ceiling of this cabin, so the floor above becomes a supported lift opening. Build the upper station afterwards. Travel works in both directions once the shaft is complete.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleDigNoLevel: There is no floor directly adjacent to this station to open a shaft into.
LanguageData.RL_VehicleDigRoof: Remove the constructed roof over the lower cabin first.
